overlay.idle: Eat every dot in the maze and dodge the four ghosts.

hint.keys: Steer with the arrow keys or W A S D, pause with P.
hint.touch: Swipe across the maze or tap the d-pad.

rules.title: How to play
rules.goal: Eat every dot to reach the next level – the ghosts get faster.
rules.pellet: The big dots make the ghosts harmless for a moment: now you can eat them, and each one is worth twice the last.
rules.lives: You have three lives and earn one more at 10,000 points.

ghost.ambusher: Schlaumeier (pink) tries to cut you off.
ghost.fickle: Zwirbel (turquoise) is hard to read – he works together with Fäger.
ghost.shy: Trödli (orange) only chases you from afar and turns away when he gets close.
